description: Bodhaka brings interactive physics and chemistry lab canvases into ChatGPT. Students build circuits, mechanics, and optics diagrams in the Physics Lab, or atoms, bonds, and balanced equations in the Chemistry Lab, all by hand on a drawing canvas inside the chat. The labs are fully interactive and render consistently on both web and mobile. Built by the team behind bodhaka.org for real, hands-on learning.
